capabilities: Search foods across Open Food Facts, USDA and FatSecret, including barcode lookup
Log meals, timestamps and comments in macro code blocks
Render macro tables, pie charts and multi-day dashboards
Track micronutrients, daily targets, streaks and adherence
Mark food intolerances with severity levels and symptoms
disambiguation: Not keyboard macros or automation; despite the name it tracks nutritional macronutrients like protein, fat and carbs.
extras: Works without any API key via Open Food Facts; FatSecret and USDA keys are optional and free. Roadmap lists imperial units, CSV/PDF export, meal plans and recipes as future work.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log meals or track calories, macronutrients and micronutrients inside notes.

relations.evidence: Open Food Facts - Community-driven database with 2.8M+ products worldwide
FatSecret API - Comprehensive commercial food database
USDA FoodData Central - Government-verified nutritional data including Foundation Foods

summary: Nutrition tracker that logs meals, macros and micronutrients in markdown tables, with food search via Open Food Facts, USDA and FatSecret.
